results.flow_input_to_sink: Caller-supplied `operator` (`address`), `approved` (`bool`), and caller identity `msg.sender` resolved via `_msgSender()` as `owner` flow directly into `_operatorApprovals[owner][operator] = approved` and the `ApprovalForAll(owner, operator, approved)` event.
results.flow_security_relevance: Mutates `_operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator]` without raffle-status restrictions or `_isProtocolDestination` screening, granting or revoking blanket ERC-721 operator authority over all current and future Raffle tickets owned by `msg.sender`. Approved operators gain full authority via `isApprovedForAll` (`ERC721.sol:110`, `167`, `389`) to re-approve or transfer `msg.sender`'s bearer raffle tickets (and thus transfer claim rights to `redeemWinningTicket` or `refundTickets`, which themselves require `msg.sender == ownerOf(ticketId)` at `packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:321` and `360`).
results.flow_summary: Grants or revokes blanket ERC-721 operator approval for a non-zero `operator` address across all Raffle tickets owned by `msg.sender`, persisting the boolean flag in `_operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator]` and emitting `ApprovalForAll`.
results.flow_terminal_action: Writes `_operatorApprovals[owner][operator] = approved` in storage and emits `ApprovalForAll(owner, operator, approved)`.
